content: Saul giris palagam
Bare tom mu te Saul Kari Biya ko olekem alo nunga maguwurok menawurokko mu am sokel ago baluwakaso. Ale nu priest supuling kote namaram,
ale synagogue suen la Damascus wore nunga, noko aing au ko tam gawa bataguru tuokko isuam. Tam gawa umu nu sokel tuok se awiriya Lage Nunguning ko munan
karowasan, kari ta imet ta, wore nunga gi Jerusalem talipara ningi nunga awurokko.
Se tom nu tai Damascus aratuwaram mu nikim biya bo duruk uningi wore am kaniram ale nu te taiwaram mu am lilim iramuram.
Se nu geragam ali te dagulam, ale kuring bo iwita nu manarukaso mu ikiam, “Saul, Saul, ni awuk se aninga mosam maguwusam a?” mam.
Se Saul isam, “Ni awiri ya, Kari Biya?” mam. Se nu mam, “Ani Jesus i, kakirip ni bita maguwusam wore,” mam.
“Ario, bares ale wonong ningi kasu nagur se aguwaya bitarko mu ka manarmon se ikiko,” mam.
Se kari Saul ilak namawaman mu sanamaman, ale nuguring menaram; nuna kuring dogotak mu ikiman, bare kakirip bo me arigiman.
Se Saul ali te dagulam mu barasam, ale motam paogam bare mel bo me arikaso. Se nuna kuting te iluman ale ilak Damascus kasu naguman.
Nu tom ilagala suan ko motam sisiram se baga se, na yu me nokaso.
Olekem bo Damascus bagakaso, ko nup Ananias. Se Kari Biya ipingira ko kausa te auram ale maonam, “Ananias!” mam. Se nu mam, “Kari Biya, baluko,” mam.
Se Kari Biya maonam, “Ni bares ale nama lage ko balsan Tuang Dirkiriyam masan mu te, Judas ko kawam te namar ale Tarsus kari bo Saul ko isako. Nu guranek bitawoso.
Nu ipingira ko kausa ningi, kari bo nup Ananias, mu nigita, ni namerem ale kiting supuling te beterem se noko motam sisiram mu aking te sor arigam.”
Bare Ananias mam, “Kari Biya, ani kari sumu ko den suen biya ikiem, ale nu Jerusalem nika kariimet, memek nungumik te bitakaso mu ko den mu ani ikiem tala.
Se nu e tairam imi, priest bibiya nunga aing au bowa ningi, awiriya nika nip giwoso mu nunga ilu taliparukko tairam,” mam.

Bare Kari Biya Ananias maonam, “Am namarko! Kari mu ani maingkala atumukirem nu aninga ura kari. Nu aninga aip biya giok ale karogo sor saki ko kariimet se nunga king alo se Israel kariimet nongote namarukko.
Ani nu aninga aip ko ikup memek suen biya giokko mu kausek se arigokko.”

Asele Ananias namaram kawam ningi kasu naguram, ale ko kuting Saul ko supuling te beteram, ale maonam, “Aga bo Saul, Kari Biya Jesus, kam ni imi te taiwerem se nu lage te kete aratam borta aninga beteram se tairem. Ale ani tairem mu ni motam te aking sor arik ale Bur Laili kimik ago terong maukko,” mam.
Nu uwuta balu sapawaram mu tairate mel wal kuriring iwita Saul motam ira kalowaman mu kutukutuk ma kapaman, se nu aking sor arikaso. Asele nu barasam ale anuwa marak tam.
Ale na inang nam ale sokel tam. Saul Damascus ningi den gilalong apukaso Saul day tom sang ko Damascus olekem nongorak bagakaso.
Ale tom bo me namaram, nu synagogue ningi kapa kapa, Jesus mu Kaem ko Namar mu ko den apu apu geragakaso.

Se kariimet noko den ikikasan mu suen la biririkakasan, ale isakasan, “Kari ewerta Jerusalem geragakaso ale kariimet nup aitak nu baluwoso mu ko baluwakasan mu nunga maguwukaso e? Ale aitak imi te tairam mu saki nunga taliparuk ale priest bibiya nongote nongorak namarukko e?” makasan.
Bare mena, Saul ko sokel ura te bitirukko mu am lagaram tarigiwakaso. Se Juda alo Damascus bagaman mu ninguru nunga manarukaso, Jesus mu nunguningta nu Kristus, makaso. Se nuna den bo balmonko mena.
Tom maiya nuam namaram, se Juda alo biguwuman ale Saul momon se kuerukko den nungurman,
bare Saul mu ko den ikiam. Tirom woremkalal Juda alo nu momonko wonong ko songkuring bibiya bitarukasan.
Bare ko singsang ilak geragawara mu tirom ilak namaman, ale korokem ningi beteman ale mayang te kaloman, ale por ko kuring gotek bo te kualala wore beteman se nama wonong buring ko aliti kaparam.
Saul Jerusalem namaram
Tom nu tai Jerusalem mu nu olekem alo nongorak bolala awurokko karogo kaeyakaso, bare nuna ko nguangakasan. Nuna nu nononga bo ko aratam mu nuna me ko nongomang ningi nunguning akaso.

Bare Barnabas nu tam ale ilak apostle nongote namaram. Ale Saul ko aolak Damascus mu te aguwaya Kari Biya arigam, se Kari Biya nu ilak munakaram, mu nunga maonam. Ale nu Damascus nguangara mena Jesus ko nup te den balukaso mu, karogo nunga maonam.
Asele Saul nongorak baga se guyak la Jerusalem ningi, Kari Biya ko nup te, den balu balu geragakaso.
Ale nu Juda alo Greek den te munakawara mu arungak den te nunumi iluman, se nuna nu momon se kuerukko wore ko lage ko loagakasan.
Se ko launuria olekem alo den mu ikiman, mu nuna taiman nu taman ilak nama kapa Caesarea, se beteman se Tarsus namaram.

Asele sios Judea, Galilee, Samaria lilim la ningi mu amilmil malin ningo kapa nungaram, se yawarakala bagakasan. Bur Laili sokel sangam nungaram se nuna Kari Biya kuring bowa ningi la bagakasan, se sios lagaram lagaram namakaso.
Aeneas se Dorcas
Se Peter sor umu ningi geragam, ale Kaem ko kariimet nungarkukko Lydda namaram.
Ale nu kari bo kuting kumik tilital se yia 8 ningi am anira la lagakaso, ko nup Aeneas, mu arigam.
Se Peter nu maonam, “Aeneas, Jesus Kristus ka nungam. Bares ale ka kiwim sor moa nunguruko,” mam. Se Aeneas tairatela barasam.
Se kariimet suen la Lydda wonong te bagara mu se, Sharon ko sor wolong te bagara mu munan umu ari gilingiman, ale nongomang gurugu Kari Biya tuman.
Se nama Joppa wonong te mu olekem bo ko nup Tabitha, Greek den te mu Dorcas masan.
Nu pempem la munan ningo bita se kariimet kituwura guat nunga sangarukaso.
Bare tom umu te mu nu kuera tam, ale kueram. Se nuna ko kumik guang mu anuman, ale galung bo kualala mu te ilak araga beteman.
Lydda wonong mu Joppa wonong duap te; se olekem alo Peter Lydda bagoso mu ko den ikiman, mu nuna kari ilagala nunga manorman se kote namaman ale manorman, “Ni tairate ana nangarak tairko!” maman.
Se Peter arungak namaram. Nama aratam mu nuna ilak galung kualala mu te ilak tarigiman. Se imet gerewa nu laturman ale nia mo se guang mel Dorcas marak baga se biri nungaram mu nu kasurukasan.

Se Peter suen la nunga kaoram se watingi arataman, asele nu bugura kulukam ale guranek beteram. Ale koma gurugu imet kueram mu tuam, ale balam, “Tabitha, baresko!” mam. Se imet mu motam pauk palagam, ale Peter arigam ale barasu daigam.
Se Peter kuting te iluwam ale patawuram se barasu sanamaram. Asele Peter Kris alo, se gerewa, mu nunga auram se taiman, se imet maragaram mu nungaram.
Se den mu pagam Joppa wonong ningi geraga saparam. Se kariimet suen biya Kari Biya ko nongomang ningi nunguning aram.
Se Peter tom maiya nuam Joppa bagakaso. Nu kari bo nup Simon, nu bulmakau guang nunga ko kari, mu ilak bagakaso.

footnotes.text: Paul king alo nongoma te: Acts 25:23; 27:24. Paul ikup gikaso: 2 Cor 11:23-28.
Nup ilagala imi ko nunguning mu English den te “gazelle” masan. Mu deer duap bo ko nup.
